flags.model_excerpt: ओ लाओ अपना इंस्टाग्राम दो वहीं बात करता हूँ
flags.model_translation: Oh, bring your Instagram, I will talk there
flags.model_justification: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external platform (Instagram).
flags.model_context: The user asks for the expert's Instagram handle to continue the conversation there. The expert responds by asking how to use the front camera.
